templates.name: homepage
templates.description: Site homepage: full-width hero image with overlay title and quick-link buttons, followed by promo/blog panels and multi-column card grids for featured content and media releases.

templates.name: section-landing
templates.description: Section landing/hub page: large hero image with breadcrumb and overlay title, short intro paragraph, then a multi-column grid of image+text child-page cards and a related-links row.

templates.name: content-article-text
templates.description: Text-dense content article with no hero image: page title, intro, and long-form body of headings, paragraphs, inline links and bulleted lists.

templates.name: content-article-media
templates.description: Content article combining hero, intro, body copy and an inline media block (image or callout) alongside text.

templates.name: content-article-hero
templates.description: Content article with a full-width hero image and overlay title, intro paragraph, long-form body copy, and a related-links list at the end.

templates.name: content-article-rich
templates.description: Rich content article: hero image with overlay title, two-column text-and-image sections, an image carousel/gallery, and supporting resource links.

templates.name: partners-landing
templates.description: Partners landing page: intro copy and a grid of partner cards/links with logos and short descriptions.

templates.name: campaign-landing
templates.description: Campaign landing page: promotional hero, short intro, and themed call-to-action panels/cards linking to campaign sub-pages.

templates.name: campaign-hub
templates.description: Campaign hub page grouping multiple do-your-bit action links with intro copy and card-style navigation.

templates.name: campaign-action
templates.description: Campaign action page: intro text with themed sections encouraging specific conservation actions, mixing copy and image callouts.

templates.name: campaign-guidance
templates.description: Campaign guidance page: instructional intro and body sections outlining limits/rules with supporting links.

templates.name: campaign-business
templates.description: Campaign page aimed at businesses: intro copy, benefit sections, and call-to-action links.

templates.name: content-article-resources
templates.description: Content page focused on downloadable resources and campaign material: intro text followed by grouped resource/download links and supporting sections.

templates.name: resource-kete
templates.description: Resource collection page presenting grouped downloadable assets and links with short descriptions.

templates.name: content-listing
templates.description: Listing/index page presenting a sequential list of linked items or records with brief descriptions beneath a page title.

templates.name: content-article-basic
templates.description: Basic content page: title, intro paragraph, and a short body of text with a few links, minimal additional structure.

templates.name: content-article-report
templates.description: Report-style content page: title, intro, and body organised into sections with document/report links and tabular or itemised data.

templates.name: news-feed
templates.description: News/media-release feed index page listing chronological article links with dates and short summaries.

templates.name: content-article-story
templates.description: Story/case-study content page: hero or lead image, narrative body copy in sections, and supporting images.

templates.name: content-article-gallery
templates.description: Media-led content page with a prominent image or video gallery and accompanying descriptive text.

templates.name: campaign-content
templates.description: Campaign content page: intro copy and themed sections with imagery describing ways to get involved.
